title: AI clones Portal 2 mechanics in 30 minutes
author: Every-Fee2260

comments.author: Deadbringer
comments.body:
So... AI copies the most trivial aspect of how portals work? Wowsers, congrats on figuring out how to teleport the user. 

The portals teleporting was not why Valve hired the Narbacular Drop students, it was the actual portalness of the portals. How you could view the world through them. Copy that using AI, and you can actually brag you copied Portal. Without it, all you have reinvented is the teleportation that has existed for pretty much all of gaming history.

comments.author: the_Luik
comments.body: I can write bad code myself, tnx

comments.author: lurklord_
comments.body: I like AI as a tool for work, but this sucks.  30 minutes is an embarrassingly long amount of time to get something like this working, even without AI.  The fact that you used AI and it still took this long pretty much invalidates any and all advice you might dole out.

replies.author: RefrigeratorLatter
replies.body: I've gotta disagree... Artists and designers finally having a tool to build games on their own is great imo. Programmers have infinite AI art generators but what do designers have? I think this is pretty sick and a good way to make game dev more accessible.

replies.author: KefkeWren
replies.body: For someone who's experienced with coding? Maybe, sure. This isn't aimed at them. How long does it take someone who has no idea what they're doing to learn the necessary skills, practice them, and *get* to the point where they could do this in under 30 minutes?

comments.author: JforceG
comments.body:
Using AI is fine, but, like…I don’t think this warrants a tutorial?
Unless it’s a tutorial on how to use the AI. Which I guess would be fine. 
Cool tool, badly named video. :P

replies.author: KefkeWren
replies.body: It's a tech demo. They're showing off what can be done with their tool.
